messages:
alex.k: Hey folks — trying to finish onboarding. Okta gives "Can't complete verification" when I try to enroll my YubiKey on my Linux laptop (Ubuntu 22.04). 1Password CLI `op signin` also keeps failing with browser flow. Also didn't get the calendar invite for the new-hire orientation. Any pointers? cc @it-helpdesk

it-helpdesk: Hey Alex — welcome! I see you in the system; we pushed provisioning but WebAuthn might not be enabled for your Okta profile on Linux. Quick troubleshooting:
- try Chrome and Firefox (we've seen Chrome on Wayland be flaky)
- run `lsusb` and paste output
- try incognito to rule out extensions

alex.k: Here's lsusb output:
```
Bus 002 Device 004: ID 1050:0407 Yubico YubiKey
Bus 002 Device 003: ID 8087:0024 Intel Corp. Integrated Rate Matching Hub
```
Tried incognito + Chrome stable 120.0. Also tried `op signin` which opens the browser and then returns "Authentication failed".

okta-bot: Provisioning complete for alex.k — Okta user created at 2026-02-18T14:10:00Z

maria.oncall: For 1Password CLI on Linux, we usually recommend using Firefox for the first sign-in, or use the headless OIDC flow if you prefer CLI-only. Example:
`eval $(op signin --account redwood)`
If browser flow errors, try `OP_ALLOW_HEADLESS=1 op signin` as a fallback (security tradeoffs).

joel-sre: YubiKey notes: ensure `libu2f-host` and `u2f-tools` are installed. On Ubuntu:
```
sudo apt install libu2f-host u2f-tools
```
If you're on Wayland+Chrome, test with X11 session or use Firefox — Wayland+u2f has regressions.

emma-peopleops: I just (re)sent the calendar invite for orientation and added you to the new-hire welcome doc. Check spam/Promotions if you don't see it.

alex.k: Switched to Firefox, installed `libu2f-host`, and retried. YubiKey enrollment succeeded and `op signin` completed. Thanks everyone! :tada:

it-helpdesk: Great — marking this thread resolved. If anything else, ping us in #help or DM.
